https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
OSTree is a tool for managing bootable, immutable, versioned file system trees.

The ostree packages have been upgraded to upstream version 2017.11, which provides a number of bug fixes and enhancements over the previous version (BZ#1494121). Notably:

* Previously, fetching updates from Satellite for Atomic Host could fail due to a problem with certificates. This update switches HTTP backed to libcurl, synchronizing with libdnf and fixes the bug. (BZ#1444903)

Users of ostree are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs and adds these enhancements.
